preconditions.description: The dimensions of the garden are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h[i][j] <= 999 for i in range(y) for j in range(x))
preconditions.description: Each cell's height is within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The number of square metres that can grow rice is within the bounds of the garden's area.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(y) for j in range(x) if is_lowest_point(i, j, h, x, y))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of cells that cannot flow water to any lower cell.
